name: openmaic
title_zh: 把多智能体互动课堂生成成可二开的本地项目
tagline_zh: 别人演示完就关掉，你却能当场生成一个能跑的多智能体课堂，还能 fork 改 provider、存储、主题。
tagline_en: Turn a live demo into your own forkable multi-agent classroom—swap providers, storage, themes, and make it yours.
desc_en: OpenMAIC assistant for setting up, generating, and extending OpenMAIC. Use when the user wants to use OpenMAIC, generate a multi-agent interactive classroom, or build on / extend / customize OpenMAIC and its @openmaic/* SDK (secondary development, 二开) — covers Live Demo or local setup, startup modes, provider keys, classroom generation, and secondary development (forking, providers/storage/themes,
why_zh: 不是包装好的黑盒，而是把 OpenMAIC 的启动、生成、二开路径全摊开，让你从「看演示」直接跳到「改。
why_en: No black box—it lays bare the full setup, generation, and extension paths, so you jump from watching a demo to editing code.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 OpenMAIC 生态；需要你本机有 Node 环境和 provider API key；生成的是课堂骨架。
limit_en: OpenMAIC-only; requires Node and provider keys; generates classroom skeleton, not content or grading—beyond that, you build it.
